title: Flowers at the foot of Mayon Volcano in bloom, days before the observance of Undas
summary: Flowers at a farm near the foothills of Mayon Volcano in Alcala, Daraga, Albay have started to bloom days ahead of the observance of All Souls’ Day and All Saints’ Day.
